Our adaptive polling PM governor (menu governor with adaptive tick) is not entering deep C-states (C3/C4) on an ARM DynamIQ platform. The CPUs stay in C1 (WFI) even during extended idle periods. Power consumption at idle is 400mW higher than expected.

C-state residency from /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/:
  state0 (WFI):     usage=4502981  time=892000000us  (dominant)
  state1 (retention): usage=12       time=480us
  state2 (power-down): usage=0       time=0us

ftrace cpuidle:
  <idle>-0 [000] 600.100: cpu_idle: state=0 cpu_id=0
  <idle>-0 [000] 600.101: cpu_idle: state=4294967295 cpu_id=0  (exit)
  <idle>-0 [000] 600.102: cpu_idle: state=0 cpu_id=0  (re-enter C0/WFI immediately)

/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/state2/disable: 0
/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/state2/latency: 500 (us)
/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/state2/residency: 2000 (us)

The menu governor predicted idle time is always below the C2 target residency. Timer frequency from /proc/timer_list shows 200+ timers firing within 1ms windows. Is timer consolidation the issue?
